## Overview

- Prefer opening workspace-backed Markdown decks in the MarkdStage canvas, enabling automatic
  refresh after source changes while retaining the existing unsaved-snapshot flow when requested.
- Keep the shared product version aligned at 4.2.4 across the Canvas Extension, Skill, npm CLI,
  and Desktop.

## Compatibility and migration

This patch release is backward compatible with existing MarkdStage Markdown decks and the v4
installation model. Update version-pinned installation links to `v4.2.4`.

| Area | Migration |
| --- | --- |
| Version-pinned installation | Update the pinned tag to `v4.2.4`. |
| Canvas deck opens | No action is required; workspace-backed decks now refresh automatically. |
